parameters.help_en: The mobile phone number. This is returned when you obtain the text message verification code
parameters.help_zh: 手机号。获取短信验证码时返回
parameters.name: phone_number

parameters.help_en:
The text message token.
When you call the operation to send a verification code using the text message verification software development kit (SDK), the end user receives a verification code. The SDK then returns an SmsToken that is used to verify the code. Android clients call the sendVerifyCode operation. iOS clients call the sendVerifyCodeWithTimeout operation. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/400434.html
parameters.help_zh:
短信Token。
当您成功调用短信验证码SDK中发送验证码接口，终端用户会收到短信验证码，SDK侧会返回用于短信验证码校验的SmsToken。其中Android客户端调用sendVerifyCode接口发送验证码，iOS客户端调用sendVerifyCodeWithTimeout接口发送验证码。详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/400434.html
parameters.name: sms_token
